title: Thin on the Ground

texts.details:
You are taking the south road into Silverpine? Then report to the Sepulcher for me. I cannot leave this post.

Know what you are walking into. Silverpine is ours on the map and nobody's on the ground. The mages of Dalaran still hold Ambermill. A wizard named Arugal sits in Shadowfang Keep, and the wolf-things he called up, the worgen, have the run of the woods. Pyrewood Village will smile at you by day. Do not be there at night.

Tell High Executor Hadrec that the rear guard holds, and that I have no one to spare him. He will have guessed.
texts.objectives: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
texts.completion:
No one to spare. Of course not.

Then you are what Tirisfal sends, and you will do. The Dark Lady wants this forest. At present the worgen have the north of it, Dalaran has the south, and what the Scourge left behind sits on Fenris Isle looking at both.

Speak to my people here, $N. There is more work than there are hands, and the hands we have keep falling off.

idea: On the road from Tirisfal to Silverpine: Arugal and the worgen, Dalaran at Ambermill, Pyrewood, and how thinly the Forsaken hold it.
